product_metadata.title: Thanksgiving Door Decorations, Fall Decorations for Home, YEAHOME Decorative Wooden Frame with Sunflowers Maple Leaves, Large Size Fall Wreaths for Front Door Outdoor Decoration for Wall Decor

🎀【Large Size Thanksgiving Decor】: This fall wreaths wall hanging size is 25cm wide * 42cm long * 9cm thick (10inches*16.5inches*3.6inches). Decorate your living room with this new colorful large wreath wall hanging that instantly transports you to a delightful fall vibe and makes your living room stand out this harvest season. It can display all fall season long, through Halloween and Thanksgiving.

🏠【Multiple Uses】: Lighted wooden frame fall wreath can be used indoor or outdoor making it a versatile decorative accessory. Hang it above your fireplace, on your front door, or on a living room wall, or place on table, mantle, porch, garden and more. This fall decoration will give you a cheerful vibe and an intense autumn feel throughout the fall.

🌻【Timer for Saving Energy】: This decorative wooden frame with lights is Battery Powered by 3*AA batteries (not included) with on/Timer/off for energy-saving. Built-in timer (6 hours on, 18 hours off) for automatic on/off convenience.

🎃【Exquisite Service】：We have upgraded the battery box and wrapped insulation around the wires to better protect the wires . Each fall decoration is carefully inspected before shipment for quality assurance, if for any reason, you are not 100% satisfied with our products, we will issue you a full refund or a replacement!
